criteria.title: Task framing
criteria.description: The ML task is correctly identified, the target named, and regression vs classification correctly chosen and justified. Assess the written justification and interpretation for this criterion. Numerical checks are scored separately. Do not infer correct code execution from prose. Unverifiable visual, repository-history or model-fitting claims must be flagged as concerns, not awarded as established facts.
